name: Xavathras
summary: Among the ruins at Constellas, Xavathras directs the Jadefire satyrs' work. He serves Xavaric and corrupts an ancient moonwell in Felwood.

sections.title: Corruptor of Constellas
sections.body: At the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood, Xavathras commands the Jadefire satyrs. Their tents stand among old elven stonework, beside a moonwell he seeks to defile for Xavaric, another satyr. Xavathras poisons its pure waters with demonic energy, deepening the corruption gripping the forest. Night elves such as Eridan Bluewind seek his death, for his work threatens any effort to restore the woodland.

aliases: who is the satyr boss constellas
faq.answer: At the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood, Xavathras commands the Jadefire satyrs. He serves Xavaric and works to corrupt the ancient elven moonwell among the ruins.
Xavathras camps among the satyr tents at the Ruins of Constellas, an ancient night elf site in southern-central Felwood.

faq.q: Why does Eridan Bluewind want Xavathras dead?
faq.answer: Eridan Bluewind wants Xavathras dead because he is corrupting a moonwell and worsening Felwood's demonic defilement. Eridan seeks to defend the forest and halt its corruption.
Xavathras works for Xavaric, another satyr in Felwood who seeks to further the Legion's lingering grasp on the corrupted forest.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see in Xavathras what became of ancient kin turned demonic beasts. He also desecrates sacred moonwells.
As a druid, you know Xavathras's poisoning of pure waters affronts nature and threatens Felwood. His work must be stopped.
